mapper.select: select root.tenant_id, count(*) as affected_instance_count, min(root.id) as sample_instance_id from batch.job_instance root where root.instance_status in ( 'SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL_FAILED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED', 'SUCCESS_DRY_RUN', 'FAILED_DRY_RUN' ) and root.finished_at is not null and root.finished_at < #{cutoff} and group by root.tenant_id order by root.tenant_id

select root.id from batch.job_instance root where root.instance_status in ( 'SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL_FAILED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED', 'SUCCESS_DRY_RUN', 'FAILED_DRY_RUN' ) and root.finished_at is not null and root.finished_at < #{cutoff} and not and not exists ( select 1 from batch.workflow_node_run node_run join batch.workflow_run workflow on workflow.id = node_run.workflow_run_id where node_run.job_instance_id = root.id and workflow.related_job_instance_id is distinct from root.id ) order by root.id asc limit #{limit} for update of root skip locked

with partitions as materialized ( select id from batch.job_partition where job_instance_id in #{id} order by id for update ), tasks as materialized ( select id from batch.job_task where job_instance_id in #{id} order by id for update ), job_steps as materialized ( select id from batch.job_step_instance where job_instance_id in #{id} order by id for update ), pipeline_steps as materialized ( select id from batch.pipeline_step_run where pipeline_instance_id in (select id from batch.pipeline_instance where related_job_instance_id in #{id}) order by id for update ), dispatches as materialized ( select id from batch.file_dispatch_record where pipeline_instance_id in (select id from batch.pipeline_instance where related_job_instance_id in #{id}) order by id for update ), workflow_runs as materialized ( select id from batch.workflow_run where related_job_instance_id in #{id} order by id for update ), workflow_nodes as materialized ( select id from batch.workflow_node_run where workflow_run_id in (select id from batch.workflow_run where related_job_instance_id in #{id}) order by id for update ), execution_logs as materialized ( select id from batch.job_execution_log where job_instance_id in #{id} order by id for update ), compensations as materialized ( select id from batch.compensation_command where related_job_instance_id in #{id} order by id for update ) select (select count(*) from partitions) + (select count(*) from tasks) + (select count(*) from job_steps) + (select count(*) from pipeline_steps) + (select count(*) from dispatches) + (select count(*) from workflow_runs) + (select count(*) from workflow_nodes) + (select count(*) from execution_logs) + (select count(*) from compensations)
